name: 40507 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40507 (Lexington) has 232 nonprofit organizations. 99 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40507 (Lexington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
